selected_evidence.requirement: Provide persistent inherited reviewer access without a periodic permission-fixing job.

selected_evidence.requirement: Keep designer as owner while reviewer can read and write.

selected_evidence.requirement: Preserve existing project contents and legacy OS/kernel.
selected_evidence.summary: Existing brief.txt remains root-owned with mode 0644 and stable checksum; RHEL 7.9 and kernel 3.10.0-1160.el7.x86_64 remain unchanged.

selected_evidence.requirement: node1 mandatory restart sequence and recovery.
selected_evidence.summary: Captures healthy pre-reboot state and boot ID, reboot acknowledgement, changed boot ID, recovered SSH/accounts/data/ACLs, and successful fresh post-reboot inheritance tests.
